style: Avant-garde art-rock and trashy theatrical body-percussion post-punk. Two competing reference pitches creating microtonal beating and constant friction without 12-TET compromise. Angular cabaret patter with lexical tone contours and glottalized vowel leaps. Asymmetric motorik pulse with fast hand claps, finger snaps, footsteps, group stomps, tongue clicks, mouth pops, breathing, and pneumatic air releases acting as rhythm and bass. Leader plus distorted echo group delivering trashy cheap-spectacle lyrics under extreme panic-under-function pressure. Dry close-miked acoustic body percussion paired with sharp high-frequency chrome shine and local crunchy distortion. High kinetic density, continuous forward motion, and constant call-and-response group shouting with abrupt structural silence interruptions and shifting acoustic perspectives that disorient the listener's spatial awareness. Extended harmonic intervals and chaotic metallic friction.

caption: An avant-garde art-punk spectacle driven entirely by body percussion, group stomps, and two competing reference pitches. A trashy, panic-fueled leader trades hocketed lines with a distorted echo group while a taxonomy-goblin premise classifies existential dread as office administration. Featuring lossy memory mutation, microtonal beating, and relentless kinematic momentum under strict phonological transfer and obsessive glottal stops across every frantic transition into total systemic collapse.
